query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

messages.content: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

message.content:
In Massachusetts, the **current maximum weekly unemployment benefit** is **$1,105 per week**.[2][4]

If you mean the **maximum total amount** you can collect on a claim, Massachusetts says you can receive benefits for up to **30 weeks** and your total benefit year amount is limited to **30 times your weekly benefit amount** or **36% of your base-period wages**, whichever is lower.[2][4]

A few practical examples:
- If you qualify for the full weekly maximum, the most you could collect in weekly benefits over 30 weeks is **$33,150** before any dependency allowances.[2][4]
- You may also receive a **$25 per dependent allowance**, in addition to the weekly benefit, if eligible.[1]

If you want, I can also help you estimate **your own maximum unemployment amount** based on your wages.
